notes: Entitlement/gratitude can involve deservedness and reciprocal obligation.
Fighter relates to conflict/harm; lover to affection.
Hard work can imply self-discipline and virtue.
Generosity/stinginess involve helping and resource sharing.
Thrifty/extravagant relates to restraint versus excess.
Chivalrous suggests protection, honor, and traditional conduct.
Punctuality relates to duty, order, and social obligation.
Chosen one can imply special status or rank.
